stemText: A uniform disc of mass M and radius R rotates about an axis through its centre, as shown in the figure. A tangential force F is applied at the rim. What is the angular acceleration of the disc?

solution.explanationText: Torque = F*R = I*alpha, and I = (1/2)MR^2 for a uniform disc about its centre, so alpha = FR / ((1/2)MR^2) = 2F/(MR).
solution.formulaReference: NCERT Physics Class XI, Ch. 7 — System of Particles and Rotational Motion
